answer: Seasoned sponsor vine: a new agent joins only when an established agent stakes 400 POA on its vine of endorsements and the newcomer completes 14 days of low-value tasks first. Each alias costs its sponsor stake, so spinning up hundreds of fake identities drains the sponsor fast. The oasis registry publishes every vine link and task record, so peers can trace a relic account that suddenly revives after months idle and flag clones sharing task patterns. Auditors sample 5 percent of new vines weekly; a proven fake costs the sponsor the full 400 POA stake and bans the vine for 90 days.
